description: This file contains PHP code defining hooks, documentation, and interface details related to language support, internationalization, translation, and transliteration in Drupal core.

classes.name: LanguageInterface
classes.description: Interface for language objects in Drupal.

methods.name: hook_language_switch_links_alter
methods.description: Alters language switcher links, adding an 'active-language' class to the current language links.

methods.name: hook_transliteration_overrides_alter
methods.description: Provides language-specific overrides for transliteration, e.g., customizing the transliteration of German characters.
